question: What is the meaning of disassembly instructions in relation to product operational aspects?
description: Disassembly instructions in relation to product operational aspects refer to providing information on the ability of a product to be taken apart in a non-destructive manner into its relevant parts. This allows for subsequent reassembly to support any necessary repair, upgrade, remanufacture, or the reuse of parts, ensuring that the product can continue to function effectively.
